title: Accountable and Explainable Methods for Complex Reasoning over Text

bias_targets.target: Spurious correlation bias (Claim-only and Overlap bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model over-reliance on dataset artifacts by measuring the frequency of predictions made using only the claim without consulting the evidence (claim-only bias), and analyzing the impact of high lexical overlap between claims and evidence on model prediction accuracy.

primary_bias_target: Spurious correlation bias (Claim-only and Overlap bias)
